{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-wiio","title":"Several replay/response protection tests broken by protect_response refactor","description":"These tests fail after the protect_response refactor:

1. 'delayed_explicit_piv_ordinary_response_ignores_peer_replay_window' - gets Err(Replay) at lib.rs:3208

2. 'dropped_pending_response_preserves_committed_window_across_large_jump' - gets Err(Replay) at lib.rs:3148

3. 'oversized_explicit_piv_response_does_not_poison_valid_retry' - gets Err(Replay) at lib.rs:2699

4. 'public_unprotect_rejects_malformed_inner_options' - gets Ok(unprotect) when malformed options should be rejected at lib.rs:3036

5. 'response_without_piv_is_one_shot_per_request' - expected Replay, got InvalidParam at lib.rs:3306

6. 'response_without_piv_requires_requester_identity' - gets Ok(protect) when should get InvalidParam at lib.rs:3269

Likely root causes:
- protect_response now directly calls fetch_increment() instead of going through reserve_sender, so the response replay window and no-PIV tracking may not be updated correctly
- The no-PIV path allocates a sequence in a way that interferes with response tracking
- Context::new defaulting to active=false means response tests that didn't call new_ephemeral have inactive contexts","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T18:19:44.29573438Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T18:19:44.29573438Z"}
